problems.source_says: The current form correctly says not_stated and does not call S2 randomized; the brief's categorical claim cannot be confirmed for the recorded Control, Single, and Duo contrasts. The paper specifies a between-subjects design but gives no random-allocation statement for those three arms. It does explicitly randomize prompts, essay order, model identity within Single, and model-to-role mapping within Duo. The latter two are genuine randomized differences in AI configuration, but the reported essay-quality and diversity contrasts pool them within the main arms; no output contrast isolating either randomized configuration is reported. Consequently those within-arm randomizations do not establish that the coded main-arm comparisons meet criterion 1, and the text also does not establish nonrandom allocation.
